patterns: APPSC asks single facts: SRC chairman = Fazl Ali; Andhra State capital = Kurnool; Andhra = first linguistic state (1 Oct 1953).
Traps rest on dates (SRC set up Dec 1953, not 1954 or August 1953) and members (Sapru, Wanchoo and Pattabhi were not members).
SRC vs SR Act counts (16+3 vs 14+6) and the SRC's para 386 Telangana formula (two-thirds, after 1961) are the recurring AP-angle facts.
The app goes deeper into the Visalandhra politics (Gentlemen's Agreement terms, Assembly vote, Nehru's remarks); the shapes are appropriate for APPSC.
